CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.has_verified_mfa()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select auth.uid() is not null
    and coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'aal', 'aal1') = 'aal2';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.has_completed_optional_mfa()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select auth.uid() is not null and (
    coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'aal', 'aal1') = 'aal2'
    or not exists (
      select 1 from public.profiles p
      join auth.mfa_factors f on f.user_id = p.id and f.status = 'verified'
      where p.id = auth.uid() and p.role in ('guardian', 'driver')
    )
  );
$function$
